stemMd: Two different solids have the same rectangular front silhouette. Which statement follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They must be the same solid

options.label: B
options.textMd: The solids must have equal volumes

options.label: D
options.textMd: One drawing must contain an error

options.label: E
options.textMd: The front silhouette alone may not determine the solid uniquely

explanationMd: Orthographic projection suppresses one spatial coordinate. Solids of different depths or hidden shapes can therefore produce the same front outline. Additional views or dimensions are needed for reconstruction.

distractorRationale.b: Depth and hidden structure are not established.
distractorRationale.c: A common elevation does not determine depth layout.
distractorRationale.a: Projection loses information along the viewing direction.
distractorRationale.d: Different objects can legitimately share a projection.
